name: menu-show-delay-zero
title: Zero Delay Gaming Profile
description: Enables Windows Game Mode and turns off background Game Bar capture. Restores your previous settings on Undo.
deepDescription:
WHAT IT CHANGES
Enables Windows Game Mode and disables background Game Bar capture for your Windows user. This avoids background game recording and lets Windows use its gaming mode. The profile saves the exact original registry values before changing them and restores them on Undo.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
This cannot make input latency literally zero. It does not change keyboard polling rate, FiveM server tick rate, ping, or hit registration. Any benefit depends on your PC and whether background recording was active. Use the in-game FPS and ping display to compare before and after.

RESTART
Restart FiveM after applying so it starts with the changed Windows settings.

UNDO
Restores the original values, including removing any values that were absent before applying.
